must_contain: case "$kind" in grok | codex) ;; *) die usage "--kind must be grok or codex" ;; esac
kind="grok"; task=""; wt_branch=""; prompt=""; pfile=""; no_wt=0; base=""; explicit_args=0; owner="${GBB_OWNER:-}"; flag_backend=""
notes: Omitted --kind becomes grok in this file. bac v1 rejects that with kind_required.
pane_id for hc is the address field hc returns. pane_id for herdr is root_pane.pane_id. gbb does not mint either.
herdr_space (sp + 32 hex) and herdr_tab (tb + 32 hex) are placement ids, not pane ids.
Webhook version at this baseline is the semver string 0.3.3, not integer 1.
Handover of an already managed pane returns the existing row and does not check owner. bac v1 returns owner_mismatch instead.
